questions.answer: The bounded US answer separates initial cost, cost-flow method and subsequent measurement. A FASB staff board handout describes ASC 330-10-30-1 as using cost as the primary basis and acquisition or production costs incurred to bring an item to its existing condition and location; that handout is non-authoritative. questions.answer: The rollforward begins with the entity and reporting period's ownership or control facts, then joins quantity and cost events: received, transferred, shipped, returned, damaged, voided and counted. questions.answer: For the bounded hospital scope, CMS identifies CMS-2552-10 as the hospital and hospital health care complex form for cost-reporting periods beginning on or after May 1, 2010.
